typography_direction.headline: ultra-bold extended grotesk or engineered display with wide stance, tight tracking, sharp terminals, and uppercase dominance
typography_direction.body: clean modern sans with strong legibility, medium optical size, compact paragraphs, and dense but breathable rhythm
typography_direction.ui: uppercase micro-labels with disciplined tracking for controls, modules, and taxonomy

shape_language.surface_geometry: rectilinear bases with selective angular cuts rather than soft cards
shape_language.radius_strategy: large exterior radii only where they add premium mass; interior controls stay tighter and more technical

logo_geometry_notes: Wordmarks rely on asymmetrical spikes, inward blade cuts, and compressed counters.
The emblem/crest form suggests a spear, trident, or weaponized motorsport insignia.
The logo reads strongest in monochrome with aggressive negative space.
Do not round the logo, soften terminals, or place it inside playful containers.
Maintain generous clearspace equal to at least the height of the A crossbar around the lockup.
iconography_rules: Use mono-line or solid icons with hard edges and restrained detail.
Avoid bubbly outline icons, emoji-like forms, or cartoon pictograms.
Prefer arrows, chevrons, gauges, grid marks, map pins, bolts, shields, and camera/media motifs with geometric precision.
Icons should feel machined, not friendly-tech.

contrast_rules.text_on_background: primary copy should rarely fall below AA contrast; large hero text should be near-white on near-black
contrast_rules.accent_usage: accents are surgical, not ambient; use on CTAs, live states, selected tabs, and data highlights only
contrast_rules.surface_separation: differentiate surfaces with texture, shadow, border sheen, and opacity before adding color

spacing_rules.macro: oversized vertical rhythm for hero and editorial sections
spacing_rules.module: 20-32px internal spacing on cards, 12-16px on compact controls
spacing_rules.density: dense information is acceptable only with clear hierarchy, labels, and sectional segmentation
spacing_rules.alignment: favor long baseline-aligned blocks and strong grid rails

motion_rules.timing: 180-280ms for UI actions, 450-700ms for hero and page moments
motion_rules.easing: use smooth deceleration and spring only where physicality helps

subject_matter: human presence used sparingly and purposefully
image_treatment_rules.grading: cool blacks, deep contrast, restrained highlights, subtle smoke or metallic warmth where needed
image_treatment_rules.cropping: tight, cinematic, confident; emphasize body lines, stance, wheels, light streaks, and environment mood
image_treatment_rules.overlays: use dark gradients and slight grain before introducing accent color overlays

ui_surface_rules.cards: premium dark panels with low-sheen borders, tinted glass or smoked metal feel
ui_surface_rules.navigation: navigation bars should feel like control surfaces or instrument rails, not SaaS nav chrome
ui_surface_rules.data_panels: analytics and admin surfaces can be cleaner but must retain brand tension through typography, contrast, and sharp segmentation
ui_surface_rules.buttons: primary buttons should feel assertive and dense; secondary buttons should feel armored rather than ghosted

do_not_do_list: Do not use generic startup illustrations.
Do not fill pages with white backgrounds.
Do not use pillowy SaaS cards everywhere.
Do not soften the logo geometry.
Do not overuse neon or gamer RGB effects.
Do not mix too many accent colors.
Do not make public pages resemble a productivity dashboard.

recommended_logo_placements.navbar: horizontal wordmark on dark field with generous breathing room
recommended_logo_placements.hero: crest or wordmark used as low-opacity monument or top-left authority stamp
recommended_logo_placements.profile_pages: small lockup near profile identity, QR module, and share cards
recommended_logo_placements.admin: simplified monochrome wordmark with cleaner utility spacing

homepage_art_direction.hero: STATIK World first, commerce second; large cinematic imagery, event urgency, profile identity, and editorial motion
homepage_art_direction.texture: smoke, machined metal, asphalt, overhead fluorescent spill, reflective paint, grain

mobile_art_direction.behavior: stack high-impact modules with sticky actions and clear segmented rails
mobile_art_direction.surfaces: thick black cards, readable overlays, strong touch targets, compressed but premium typography

admin_ui_art_direction.tone: internal operations center, cleaner than public site but still unmistakably STATIK
admin_ui_art_direction.layout: dark command-center modules, high-density tables, strong filters, audit visibility
visual_rules: neutral graphite base with hard white contrast
large overview metrics with crisp segmentation
